placements.title: Deployment Gates
placements.frame: How does the organization structure, enforce, and govern verification gates across deployment pipelines?

placements.title: Signed Release Manifests Guard Deployment Pipelines
placements.frame: How are release integrity gates and artifact signatures enforced across staging and production deployments?
placements.why: Quinton mandates that every Meridian deployment requires a signed release manifest across staging and production to prevent unsigned artifacts from shipping.
